notes: News: official MW4 Season 1 patch notes Nov 10 + Nov 11 entries (callofduty.com, Infinity Ward) + Warzone S1 patch notes Nov 11 (Raven, same hitscan change). 2nd sources: HardcoreSND, JobilleHQ. Dup check: S1 launch post (06.11.) covered the Season 1 launch notes, not these updates; no other patch post. Scheduled Sat 14.11. 18:00.

slides.title: HITSCAN BUFF
settings: All ballistic weapons, at all ranges
Average now: inside it, bullets hit instantly
Faster: new bullet simulation, shots connect sooner

slides.title: DMZ CHANGES
slides.foot: X01 = THE NEW SEASON 1 EXCLUSION ZONE UNDER HAJIN
settings: Can't be deployed in X01 anymore
Cash for loot value + deploy time when you fail to exfil (not in Story Missions)
Solos + duos earn Bounties slightly faster

slides.title: MP CHANGES
settings: Switches back to hip sensitivity earlier
Did more damage than intended to killstreak vehicles
Prestiging could remove ammo attachments from Blueprints
Closing doors now destroy Tripwires instead of leaving them active

cta.sub: TELL US AFTER YOUR NEXT MATCH
